title: Workmanship Replacement Terms — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
A Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty tire with a manufacturing defect — tread separation, out-of-round, belt shift or a bead that will not seal on a sound wheel — is replaced on the set.

1. The set must be in status active when a workmanship replacement is made.
2. The replacement must be made no later than the end of the warranty term counted from the tire purchase recorded on the original sales ticket. Months are counted as calendar months from the anchor date to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist. The term is the line's warranty term in months.
3. A tire damaged by a road hazard, curb impact or under-inflation has no defect and is not a workmanship replacement.

**Free period and share — clauses no longer in force.**
- The clause first issued as "replacement is free, with free mounting and balancing, while the replacement date is within the line's free-replacement months of the purchase date and the tread worn (new-tire depth less the inspection's lowest main-groove depth) is at most the line's free-replacement tread worn" is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis of the workmanship share.
- The clause "once either limit is passed the customer pays the tread-worn share of the store's current selling price — the tread worn divided by the usable tread (new-tire depth less wear-out depth), rounded half up to the cent — plus the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire when the line charges mounting after the free period" is no longer in force as an unqualified rule. It holds for every workmanship replacement other than the workmanship share charged on a tire a Crestline store found defective at a tread inspection and replaced at that visit; for that share, the workmanship share percentage is the prorated share less every part of it that share's own terms take off, each a percentage of the prorated share worked out on its own, never below 0.

**Term, both sides (hypothetical dates):** on a 60-month line, a set bought on 15 March may have a defective tire replaced through 15 March five years later and not on 16 March.

superseded_clauses: Replacement is free, with free mounting and balancing, while both of these hold: the replacement date is within workmanship_free_replacement_months of purchase_date, and the tread worn (original_tread_depth_32nds minus the inspection's min_tread_depth_32nds) is at most workmanship_free_replacement_wear_32nds.

Once either limit is passed the customer pays the tread_worn_share of the current_selling_price, which is the tread worn divided by the usable tread (original_tread_depth_32nds minus wear_out_tread_depth_32nds), rounded half up to the cent, plus mounting_balancing_charge_per_tire when workmanship_mounting_charged_after_free_period is true.
